readingProtocol: Phase 1 is entirely read-only. Display this entire packet, the entire reading manifest, all metadata and every listed page, and the complete workflow and rubric. Use one file per returned result with ample outer and inner token budgets, and literal consecutive sed line ranges for the long manifest. Hash-only reads do not establish reading. Report READY FOR AUTHENTICATION; write nothing.

Only after controller authentication in this same context, write the one complete publication output with apply_patch. Preserve every template identity, score, section, row and move. Do not write placeholders or other files. No overwrite, recursive retry, or model-authored totals.

In memory before the one delivery, check every critique independently against the full contract: 105–130 words, at least 880 characters, exactly four labeled sentences. Target 112–118 words; ordinary compound wording is preferable to padding. Ensure distinctive source-grounded strengths, limitations and burdens, no reused templates.

All audio restrictions apply. Do not attribute recording uncertainty, garbled words, other speakers’ comments or a caption artifact to a participant. Do not portray guided evolution as denial of evolution, or a first-cause concession as interventionist theism. Judge historical/scientific assertions as offered arguments, not independently verified facts.

Keep AI Contribution natural and argument-first, with no provenance launchers or mirrored scaffolding. Preserve ordinary punctuation. Tags and blunder links remain empty until independent rhetorical review.

Do not read original primary judgments, anonymous dispute options, original full ledger, rejected assessments, other debates, published precedent prose, biography research, unlisted files, histories, private logs, credentials or network. Do not spawn agents or make paid calls.
